T0538.title: Malicious Package
T0538.definition: A software package that contains hidden code for credential theft, backdoors, data exfiltration, or other abuse.
T0538.description: Malicious packages hide code for credential theft, backdoors, build tampering, or data exfiltration behind normal-looking dependencies. Governance should combine package-source reputation, anomalous version review, install-script inspection, dependency locking, sandboxed builds, and artifact signing to reduce supply-chain contamination.
T0538.usageExample: Assess Malicious Package related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
